ABOUT YOUR TEACHER

Guiding Your Practice With Intention & Care

Namaste! I’m Deena. As an independent freelance yoga teacher, my mission is to strip away the rigidity of massive commercial studios and offer you an intimate, authentic sanctuary for personal transformation.

Whether you are stepping onto the mat for the very first time or seeking to deepen a complex asana and breathwork practice, I work with you closely to honor your unique anatomical structure, mental pace, and wellness goals.

Personalized Guidance

Direct feedback and adjustments tailored to your body.

Safe, Supportive Space

A nurturing environment free from judgment or comparison.

TEACHING PHILOSOPHY

Mindful Movement Meets Modern Grace

Yoga is not about touching your toes; it is about what you learn on the way down. My classes integrate traditional wisdom with contemporary functional movement.

Conscious Breathwork

Pranayama techniques woven into every single session to calm your nervous system, anchor your thoughts, and revitalize your daily energy.

Functional Alignment

Thoughtfully sequenced flows that honor modern biomechanics while inviting somatic freedom, core strength, and sustainable flexibility.

Holistic Connection

Cultivating deeper self-awareness that transcends the mat, helping you navigate work stress, sleep better, and live with intention.
